# Always-on Usage
> A usage and workflow encyclopedia for always-on agents (Grok Bot, OpenAI Dots, Meta Muse): which one fits which job, what burns quota, and how to set them up cheaply. For people who want to run bots long-term without burning their quota. An evaluation layer, not a template directory. Comparisons and the calculator are directional estimates, not vendor SLAs; cases aggregate public posts (1781 items plus 26 X stories), each with its author and original link. Grok Bot has the most entries; public Dots and Muse cases are added round by round. Published by Incidental AI.

- Site: https://usage.incidental.site/
- Languages: en (default), zh-CN, zh-TW, ja, ko, ms, vi, fr, es, de — append ?lang=<code>
- Sitemap: https://usage.incidental.site/sitemap.xml
- Full text for LLMs: https://usage.incidental.site/llms-full.txt
- Last updated: 2026-10-21T22:43:03.181Z

## Pages
- /compare.html: Grok Bot / OpenAI Dots / Meta Muse comparison matrix
- /cases/: public case aggregation (search + type/product filters)
- /stories/: X stories
- /sources.html: sources
- /calculator.html: quota-risk calculator
- /about.html: positioning
